requirements: Humanlike female spirit without invented monster parts
variant: Hyldemoer in the Danish elder-woman guardian interpretation, a female tree spirit at the elder tree she inhabits.
aura: Ancient watchful protective tree guardian, quietly formidable and ambivalent.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square detailed painterly naturalistic folklore encyclopedia illustration of the Elder Mother or Danish Hyldemoer, selecting the ELDER-TREE GUARDIAN interpretation rather than a battle witch. One mature humanlike female spirit, grey hair and weathered wise face, fully clothed in a simple dark green rustic long dress and wrap, standing close to an ELDER TREE (Sambucus) with characteristic compound leaves and flat clusters of small cream-white blossoms. Her presence seems to emerge from the shadows at the trunk, without turning arms or legs into branches. One hand rests protectively on the elder bark, the other held close; ordinary human anatomy, full figure framed. Northern woodland dusk with filtered warm light, solemn wary gaze and calm powerful posture evoke a protective tree spirit who must be respected, not a cute fairy. The sources do not fix special monstrous anatomy: no invented horns, pointed ears, antlers, wings, glowing eyes, crown, twig hair, bark skin or branch limbs. No axe, attackers, victims, children or other beings. No text, runes, labels, borders or watermark. Contemporary artistic interpretation of the documented elder-woman guardian, not an assertion of an established costume.
